startGameTipDesc7.en:
<size=25>[0.8.1011 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/28/2021
1. Bug fix: Saves would get corrupted. Contact us if this issue still occurs, and please manually backup your saves.
 (Save folder: C:\\Users\\Username\\AppData\\LocalLow\\guigugame\\guigubahuang\\Steam\\CacheData)
2. Optimization: More Bag slots.
3. Optimization: Shortened time needed while traveling on the world map.
4. Optimization: More Elixirs sold in towns.
5. Optimization: Rewards of town missions and sect missions.
6. Optimization: Distance requirement when picking up items during combat.
7. Optimization: Increased Venerable Tortoise's Vitality in Spiritlock Circle.
8. Optimization: Nerfed Three-legged Crow.
9. Bug fix: Promotion Duels couldn't be triggered after some sect missions had been completed.
10. Bug fix: Evergreen boss couldn't be stunned.
11. Bug fix: Earth Bolt couldn't deal damage after hitting enemies.
12. Bug fix: Game would freeze if players previewed Manuals on the battle results page.
13. Bug fix: Players couldn't enter Taihang Mountains while using Aerogear.
14. Bug fix: Some areas incorrectly required 50 Fire Root stat to enter.
15. Bug fix: Sound effects would be played multiple times when Stamina or Health was too low.
16. Bug fix: Some rewritten Destinies and summoned units would get lost after players entered a new room.
17. Bug fix: Errors occurred while storing items in the Tree Vault.
18. Optimization: Opponents' strengths in Sect Tryouts and Promotion Duels.
19. Optimization: Shortened freezing durations of ice skills.
20. Bug fix: Wrong stats of the Destiny (Nature): Happy Bachelor.
21. Bug fix: Wrong number of shards needed for combining Heaven Aura and Earth Aura.
22. Bug fix: Wrong probabilities of adventure events being triggered.
23. Optimization: Requirements for casting Heavenly Giant; stats of summoned units.
24. Optimization: Increased Vitality of some units summoned by skills.
25. Optimization: Some music and sound effects.

startGameTipDesc71.en:
<size=25>[0.8.2015 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 2 AM, 4/10/2021
1. New: Added the Invite feature.
2. Bug fix: Counterattack's damage boost effect didn't work on Special Skills, Ultimate Skills, or Motion Skills.
3. Bug fix: Blade Field Skills couldn't take effect on special units.
4. Bug fix: Rock Formation's affix would cause players to be unable to clear the room.
5. Bug fix: When a Wind Motion Skill was active, Wind Field Skill's damage boost couldn't take effect in the beginning.
6. Bug fix: Lightning Motion Skill's affix didn't take effect.
7. Bug fix: Clones created by Water Motion Skills would use Ultimate Skills and Field Skills.
8. Bug fix: Some affixes of Special Skills would be triggered multiple times, messing up their cooldown.
9. Bug fix: Divinity Sword's effects could be triggered by Motion Skills even if it didn't have an affix.
10. Bug fix: Chongming's Divine Soul Skill couldn't take effect under some circumstances.
11. Bug fix: Incorrectly displayed duration of Mind Skill's affix.
12. Bug fix: Incorrectly displayed Energy value of Gouchen's Divine Soul Skill.
13. Bug fix: New cursor styles couldn't be properly shown after players interacted with NPCs.
14. Bug fix: The leech effect in Tao Realms couldn't take effect when Wind Motion Skills were cast.
15. Bug fix: Effects of some affixes would disappear after players entered a new room in Tao Realms.
16. Optimization: some NPC dialogue.

<size=25>[0.8.1012 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/28/2021

 If you need to move or backup your saves, please go to this folder: C:\\Users\\Username\\AppData\\LocalLow\\guigugame\\guigubahuang\\Steam\\CacheData

<size=25>[0.8.1013 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 1/28/2021
1. Optimization: Some requirements for casting Ultimate Skills were too hard to meet.
 Fire Phoenix: Flames now last longer, making it easier to kill enemies.
 Heavenly Icy Eye: Killing enemies inflicted with Frost will generate stacks.
2. Optimization: Higher chance of getting Ultimate Skills and high-rarity Manuals in auctions.
3. Bug fix: No notifications after killing low-Realm Cultivators from the same faction regarding reduced Reputation.
4. Bug fix: Killing Cultivators from the enemy faction would also result in losing Reputation.
5. Bug fix: Animation was too fast when trying to pick up an item from far away.
6. Bug fix: Some skills didn't show damage dealt.
7. Bug fix: When generating the world map, only 5 of 6 Qi areas would appear. (You need to create a new save. Old saves can only be fixed after a future patch.)
8. Bug fix: Players had to fight themselves in Sect Tryouts.
9. Bug fix: After a battle in East Sea, players would be teleported to Hundred Thousand Hills.
10. Bug fix: Corpse Lord could leech Vitality non-stop.
11. Optimization: Lowered Focus needed for Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
12. Optimization: Easier to sell items.
13. Optimization: Probabilities of some rewritten Destinies and their stats.
